description:
Founded to transform retail finance, Ajaib Group is an Indonesian fintech unicorn breaking barriers to financial access. Having recently secured a $270M Series C—the single largest funding round in Southeast Asia over the past four years—we are backed by premier global investors including Y Combinator, Ribbit Capital, SoftBank, and SBI Holdings.

To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully remote work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are. We operate with an impact-driven purpose where everyone is the owner of our customers' satisfaction. Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.

Role Overview

As a Backend Engineer in the Money team, you build and maintain backend services behind customer accounts and money movement, working on well-defined tasks with guidance from senior engineers. You write clean, tested code, learn how banking-grade systems stay exact and auditable, and grow quickly toward owning features on your own.

Build and maintain backend services and APIs for accounts, balances, transfers and payments, following the team's designs and standards
Deliver well-scoped tasks from implementation to production, with unit and integration tests
Follow the rules of money handling: exact amounts, idempotent requests, clear transaction states and audit trails
Help with integrations with banks and payment partners, and with daily batch and reconciliation jobs
Take part in code reviews, both receiving and giving feedback, and learn from them
Investigate bugs and production issues with help from senior engineers, and fix them with tests that prevent them from coming back
Write clear technical notes and documentation for the work you do
Ask questions early, raise risks and communicate progress to your team, Product and Operations

Requirements

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
Experience: 2+ years of professional backend engineering, including working on services in production
Languages: Solid in Java, Go or another modern backend language
Fundamentals: Good understanding of REST APIs, relational databases and SQL, and basic concurrency
Data & Messaging: Working knowledge of transactions, and exposure to caching (Redis) and messaging (Kafka)
Tools: Comfortable with Git, Docker and CI/CD, with exposure to a cloud platform (GCP or AWS)
Mindset: Careful, curious and eager to learn, with clear communication. Experience in banking, payments, e-wallets or another regulated environment is a plus but not required

Benefits

Performance Bonus - Get rewarded for the impact you make
Private Insurance - Comprehensive health coverage for you
Paid Time Off - Take the time you need to recharge and come back stronger
Learning & Development - Company-sponsored training, courses, and professional certifications
Hybrid Work Arrangement - Enjoy the flexibility of working both remotely and from the office
Career Growth - Work closely with experienced leaders and take on meaningful ownership as we scale
Employee Perks - Enjoy exclusive discounts, partnerships, and lifestyle perks
Collaborative & High-Ownership Culture - Work with smart, driven people in cross-functional teams, take ownership, and make a meaningful impact for our users

Role Overview

As a Staff Engineer (Backend) in the Money team, you set the technical direction for the systems that hold and move customers' money across several teams: the ledger and account platform, transfers and payments, bank integrations, reconciliation and end-of-day processing. You solve the hardest problems around correctness, consistency and reliability for money that must always add up, and you make the engineers around you stronger. You stay hands-on where it matters most.

Define the technical direction and architecture for ledger, account and payment systems that span several teams
Lead the design of fault-tolerant, consistent and secure services, and review critical designs from other teams
Lead the ledger architecture: double-entry model, balance computation at scale, holds, reversals and complete audit trails
Set the standard for correctness in money flows: idempotency, clear transaction states, distributed transaction patterns and safe handling of unknown results
Design the platform for connecting to many banks and payment networks, including routing, failover, monitoring of success rates and cut-off handling
Design reconciliation, settlement and end-of-day processing that find every difference quickly and fix it at the root
Design fraud and risk controls that fit into real-time money flows without hurting normal customers
Plan for peak load and failure scenarios, and drive load testing, capacity planning and disaster recovery
Identify technical risks early, weigh trade-offs and drive decisions that fit business and regulatory needs
Lead investigations and root cause analysis for complex production incidents, and drive lasting improvements
Set and promote engineering standards for reliability, observability, security and performance
Partner with Engineering Managers, Product, Finance, Risk and Compliance on cross-team initiatives
Mentor Senior Engineers and help grow technical leadership across the team
Stay hands-on with implementation for critical components and complex problems

Requirements

Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
Experience: 8+ years of professional software engineering, with a proven record of designing and running large-scale distributed systems that handle money or other critical transactions, and leading technical work across teams
Languages: Highly proficient in Java, Go or another modern backend language
System Design & Architecture: Strong expertise in microservices, event-driven architectures, distributed transactions, reliability engineering, observability and performance optimization
Banking Domain: Strong working knowledge of ledgers, payment networks, bank integrations, reconciliation and batch processing, or equivalent depth in large payment or e-wallet systems
Data & Messaging: Deep practical experience with Kafka, Redis, and relational databases, including transactions, locking, query tuning and data consistency
Infrastructure: Experience designing and operating applications on cloud platforms (GCP, AWS)
Mindset & Domain: Background in banking, payments, e-wallets or another high-scale, regulated financial environment. Strong communication, with the ability to influence technical decisions without direct authority

Benefits

Performance Bonus - Get rewarded for the impact you make
Private Insurance - Comprehensive health coverage for you

Learning & Development - Company-sponsored training, courses, and professional certifications
Hybrid Work Arrangement - Enjoy the flexibility of working both remotely and from the office

Employee Perks - Enjoy exclusive discounts, partnerships, and lifestyle perks

Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain RESTful APIs in Java / Spring Boot that power a multi-tenant SaaS platform: endpoints, validation, pagination/sorting/filtering, reporting and dashboard data, audit trails.
Own the data layer end to end: JPA entities, DAOs and repositories, native queries, views, and stored procedures across MySQL, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL. Design schemas and tune slow queries.
Harden tenant isolation, authentication, and authorization so every request sees only the data it is entitled to.
Refactor and decompose large legacy services into well-bounded, testable components without disrupting production.
Write unit and integration tests, and raise the bar on coverage, structured logging, and error handling.
Define and document API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger) and work with front-end engineers (TypeScript) to keep them in sync.
Give and receive thorough code reviews, and use AI coding assistants as part of the daily workflow while reviewing their output with the same rigor as any other contributor's.

Qualifications

5+ years of professional backend development in Java, with deep hands-on Spring Boot experience (Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security).
A track record of designing and building RESTful APIs for business applications: contracts, versioning, validation, pagination, error semantics.
Strong relational database skills: schema design, JPA/Hibernate mappings, native SQL, query optimization. Hands-on with more than one of MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL.
Working knowledge of TypeScript: enough to read a front-end codebase, debug API consumption, and make small changes.
Experience working in and improving large, mature codebases: breaking up oversized services, adding tests, untangling dependencies.
Solid grasp of API security: authentication and authorization, multi-tenancy, input validation, secrets handling.

description:
我们是一家业务覆盖全球的数字资产与金融科技平台，团队分布在亚太多个国家和地区。

工作地点：亚太地区，全远程办公；全职。



- 钱包账户体系：

- 负责钱包账户系统的架构设计与演进，统一管理助记词、私钥、硬件、MPC、托管（Turnkey 等）、机器人钱包、保险箱等多类账户形态。

- 钱包核心服务：

- 负责钱包核心后端服务的设计与开发，覆盖资产管理、代币列表、交易历史、上链广播、Gas 策略等关键链路。

- 负责大规模钱包数据（账户、资产、交易历史等亿级数据量）的存储设计、查询性能与版本兼容性。

- 负责钱包与中台基础能力（行情、Token、节点 RPC、资产）的集成与解耦，推动公共能力下沉、钱包业务上浮。

- 多链支持与上链：

- 负责钱包多链支持的接入与维护，覆盖 EVM、Solana 及其他主流公链。

- 负责交易构造、签名、广播、状态追踪的完整链路，保障在网络拥堵、Nonce 冲突等场景下的稳定性。



技术基础

- 5 年以上后端开发经验，3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。

- 熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。

- 精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理；具备亿级数据量场景下的存储设计与查询优化经验。

- 主导过中大型后端系统从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地，具备账户、订单、资产等核心域的建模经验。

- 至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理，熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

- 熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Move / Sui 者优先。

- 熟悉交易构造、签名、广播、Nonce 管理、Gas 策略等链上交易全链路，具备主网钱包或交易系统的实战经验。

- 具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

钱包专项

- 熟悉主流钱包账户体系，包括助记词 / 私钥 / 硬件钱包 / MPC / 托管钱包等的原理与差异，理解各类账户的安全模型与使用场景。

- 具备钱包后端的实际开发经验，主导或深度参与过账户系统、资产模块、交易历史等核心模块的设计与落地。

- 具备多账户体系融合、抽象与对外开放能力建设的经验，或对此方向有清晰的方法论。

AI 工程能力

- 日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。

- 具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。

- 了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。



- 有 MPC / TSS 钱包后端的开发经验，或熟悉 Turnkey、Fireblocks、Privy 等托管钱包方案。

- 有 AA 智能合约钱包（EIP-4337 / EIP-7702、Safe、Biconomy 等）相关的开发经验。

- 有亿级数据量下的数据迁移、版本兼容、双写切换等实战经验。

- 有钱包安全相关经验（密钥管理、签名风控、欺诈检测等）。

- 有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。

- 有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。



中文为主要工作语言，需具备流利的中文沟通与书面表达能力；具备英文工作能力者优先。



全远程办公、有竞争力的薪酬、全球化的团队与业务视野。

Amartha adalah perusahaan teknologi finansial terkemuka yang berfokus pada pemberdayaan perempuan pengusaha mikro di pedesaan melalui layanan keuangan inklusif. description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Transaction Monitoring Analyst to join our Compliance team. You will be responsible for reviewing and analyzing alerts triggered by our transaction monitoring systems, conducting investigations, and escalating suspicious activities in accordance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. This is a key control role in safeguarding the platform against money laundering, terrorist financing, and other financial crimes.
Key Responsibilities:
Review and assess alerts generated by the transaction monitoring system for potential suspicious activity.
Conduct in-depth investigations of flagged transactions, including analysis of customer profiles, transaction patterns, and supporting documentation.
Decide whether alerts should be closed as no further action required or escalated for further review or SAR filing.
Maintain clear and concise documentation of investigation findings and rationale.
Collaborate with other compliance teams (e.g., KYC, Sanctions, Fraud) to ensure a holistic approach to financial crime risk management.
Stay up to date with evolving AML regulations, typologies, and industry best practices.
Provide feedback to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of transaction monitoring rules and scenarios.
Requirements:
1-3 years of experience in transaction monitoring, AML, or financial crime compliance, preferably within the fintech or crypto industry.
Strong understanding of AML regulations and red flags related to money laundering and terrorist financing.
Excellent analytical and investigative skills with strong attention to detail.
Ability to make sound, risk-based decisions in a fast-paced environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in both English and Mandarin.
A proactive team player who is collaborative, adaptable, and eager to learn.
Preferred Qualifications:
Relevant certifications such as CAMS, ICA, or equivalent are a plus.
Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools (e.g., Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs) is a plus.
What We Offer:
Competitive salary.
Flexible remote work arrangements.
Opportunity to work with a diverse, global team.
Career growth and development opportunities.

description:
Job Description
We're looking for an experienced sales leader to help us scale in APAC. This is a pivotal role for a leader who combines strategic vision with hands-on execution.
As the Senior Sales Leader, Asia Pacific, you will be responsible for leading the regional go-to-market effort in one of the fastest-growing markets for data infrastructure. You'll have the autonomy to build the team, define the strategy, and drive the revenue needed to fuel our next phase of growth. You will manage complex enterprise deals, develop strategic partnerships, and serve as the face of Hydrolix in the region.
This is an exciting opportunity for a driven sales leader who wants to make a meaningful impact at a well-funded, rapidly growing startup and be part of the company's leadership team. You will be managing a team of Account Executives and Solutions Engineers, supported by the sales development organization.
The ideal candidate will be someone with a demonstrated history of building high-performing sales teams from the ground up in the APAC region, with a particular focus on infrastructure technology.
We're looking for a "player-coach": someone who can build and lead a team while remaining hands-on with key accounts and opportunities.
Key Responsibilities
- Lead and develop the regional sales organization across APAC, including hiring, mentoring, and managing a team of Account Executives and Solutions Engineers
- Own regional revenue targets and drive consistent quarter-over-quarter growth
- Build and manage a robust pipeline of enterprise opportunities across the region
- Develop and execute the regional go-to-market strategy in alignment with company objectives
- Personally engage in strategic deals, executive-level relationships, and key partnerships
- Collaborate with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to ensure customer satisfaction and drive expansion
- Represent Hydrolix at industry events, conferences, and executive briefings
What You'll Bring
- 7+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, with at least 3 years in a sales leadership role
- Proven track record of building and scaling high-performing sales teams in APAC
- Deep understanding of the data infrastructure market, including data lakes, streaming data platforms, and real-time analytics
- Strong network of enterprise contacts and partners across the APAC region
- Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
- Self-motivated, results-driven, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced startup environment
The successful candidate will be a player-coach: capable of leading and developing the regional sales organization while remaining personally engaged with strategic customers, major opportunities, executive relationships and key partners.
About Hydrolix
Hydrolix is a Portland-based company revolutionizing data infrastructure. We offer a high-performance, cost-effective data lake platform built for massive-scale log data, with real-time streaming and batch ingestion capabilities.
We are a remote-first company with employees across the US, Canada, Europe and APAC. We offer competitive compensation, including equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. Hydrolix values customer focus, innovation, and execution. Our culture is built on the following values:
Integrity: We do the right thing even when no one is watching.
Bias for action: We move fast and deliver results.
Customer obsession: We put the customer first in everything we do.
Intellectual honesty: We value truth over comfort.
Ideal Candidate Profile
- Bachelor's degree in business, computer science, engineering, or a related field; MBA preferred
- Proven success selling infrastructure technology to enterprise customers in APAC
- Experience with consumption-based or SaaS pricing models
- Background in log management, SIEM, CDN analytics, or adjacent infrastructure categories
- Existing senior relationships across APAC enterprise and partner ecosystems
title: Senior Sales Leader
